original_incident_summary: Shipment SH-4105 is delayed due to primary port closure, containing 250 tons of consumer electronics scheduled for WH-SOUTH-303 with a CRITICAL_DELAY routing decision.
final_operations_brief: Shipment SH-4105 will be rerouted via ROUTE-CENTRAL-03 to Port-Central and WH-CENTRAL-404, incurring an added delay of 96 hours, with the selected warehouse operating at 54% utilization and normal risk tier.
